html.Nejstarší a nejvýznamnější památka Touži: Toužim's oldest and most important historic building. A provostry became a castle, the castle became a château, then decades of decay. Since 2015 it has been coming back to life.
html.Krajinu na horním toku Střely dostává od: The ruler grants the land on the upper reaches of the Střela river to the nobleman Jiří of Milevsko. On the site of the castle he builds a manor, probably named after its first steward, Túžim ("longed-for son").
html.Jiří zakládá premonstrátský klášter v Mi: Jiří founds the Premonstratensian monastery in Milevsko and also bequeaths the Toužim area to it. The Premonstratensians turn the manor into a provostry with the Church of St John the Baptist.
html.Proboštství vyplenili šlechtici bojující: The provostry is plundered by nobles fighting against King Wenceslas IV, and Provost Jiří is taken prisoner.
html.Král Zikmund dává panství do zástavy hus: King Sigismund pledges the estate to the Hussite captain Jakoubek of Vřesovice. With his son Jan he rebuilds the provostry as a Gothic castle, today the core of the Upper Castle (Jan's Castle).
html.Král Jiří z Poděbrad povoluje měšťanům v: King George of Poděbrady allows the townspeople of plundered Útviny to build a new fortified town next to the castle. Toužim is founded.
html.Panství získávají páni z Plavna. Přistav: The estate passes to the Lords of Plauen. They add a late Gothic palace and in the first half of the 16th century rebuild the castle in Renaissance style: the Upper and Lower Castle, a manor farm and a garden with a fountain are created.
The estate is inherited by the Lobkowicz family of Hasištejn.
html.Zámek i město vyhořely. O tři roky pozdě: The castle and town burn down. Three years later Duke Julius Henry of Saxe-Lauenburg buys the estate and rebuilds the castle as an early Baroque residence with a park and a summer house. The Church of St John the Baptist disappears; the Chapel of the Holy Cross stands in its place.
html.Další požár. Při obnově vzniká nový pans: Another fire. During the rebuilding a new manorial brewery is built.
html.Panství dědí bádenská markrabata. Zámek: The estate is inherited by the Margraves of Baden. The castle no longer serves as a noble residence, only for farming and administration.
html.Zámek znovu vyhořel. Dolní zámek dostává: The castle burns down again. The Lower Castle gets its present late Baroque appearance.
html.Panství připadá panovníkovi. Část chátra: The estate passes to the sovereign. Part of the decaying castle is demolished.
html.Horní zámek přichází o celé horní patro: The Upper Castle loses its entire top floor with the tower, and both wings. The garden with the summer house disappears too.
html.Panství kupuje v dražbě vévoda Alfred Be: Duke Alfred Beaufort-Spontin buys the estate at auction. The family keeps it until 1945.
html.Zámek přechází na stát. Využívá ho armád: The castle passes to the state. It is used by the army, a state farm, the district national committee and later the town.
html.Kvůli panelovému sídlišti jsou zbořeny n: Some of the farm buildings are demolished to make way for a prefab housing estate.
html.Obnova, připravovaná od 70. let, se úpln: Restoration, in preparation since the 1970s, comes to a complete halt.
html.Město zámek prodává soukromé osobě. Záme: The town sells the castle to a private owner. It falls into decay and is damaged by vandals.
html.Město Toužim získává zámek zpět jako rui: The town of Toužim gets the castle back as a ruin.
First volunteer work day in the courtyard.
The Živý zámek Toužim association is founded.
html.Jak zámek vypadal kolem roku 1700: What the castle looked like around 1700
html.Z rozsáhlého panského sídla se dochovalo: Of the extensive manorial seat, mainly the core has survived: the Upper and Lower Castle, the manorial brewery, the fountain, the Chapel of the Holy Cross and part of the manor farm. Surviving parts are highlighted in yellow in the drawing.
html.Dolní městská brána s masnými krámy a zá: Lower town gate with butchers' stalls and the castle armoury
html.Dům hejtmana, správce poplužního dvora: Steward's house (manager of the manor farm)
html.Hlavní rezidence. Tvoří ho pozůstatek ob: The main residence. It is built around the remains of the provostry's living quarters, rebuilt as a castle after 1437. On the west and south sides, walls with a round bastion and the entrance gate have survived. The Renaissance rebuilding turned it into a grand château, which was altered again after the fires of 1620, 1652 and 1752. In the early 19th century it lost a whole floor along with its tower.
html.Vznikl renesanční přestavbou gotického p: It was created by the Renaissance rebuilding of the Gothic outer ward and was used to run the estate. After the 17th-century fires it was given a painted beamed ceiling; its present appearance dates from late Baroque alterations after 1752. There was a water cistern in the cellars. The north wing was demolished in the 19th century, leaving only the riding hall. In the courtyard stands the base of a column of St John of Nepomuk from 1800.
html.Panský pivovar stál v zahradě nejpozději: The manorial brewery stood in the garden from 1661 at the latest, and its cellar has survived. The present brewery building is a Baroque new build from after 1752. In front of it stands a stone fountain from the castle garden. The Chapel of the Holy Cross replaced the provostry's Church of St John the Baptist.
html.Byla založena severně od zámku snad už p: It was laid out north of the castle, perhaps as early as before 1620, and greatly enlarged after 1625. A French-style park with ponds, fountains, an orchard, a gardener's house and a Renaissance summer house was enclosed by a stone wall. The garden disappeared in the 19th century and today most of its area is covered by a housing estate.
html.Založen před rokem 1544 severovýchodně o: Founded before 1544 north-east of the castle. Besides farming it also served for defence: the three-winged complex by the town wall formed a massive bastion with loopholes. It included farmhands' quarters, cowsheds, a granary, a barn, stables, a coach house, the steward's house and a dovecote. The Jewish Gate to the ghetto in Předměstí led through the east wing.
html.Dolní neboli Rybářská brána měla v 17. s: In the 17th century the Lower or Fishermen's Gate housed the castle armoury on its upper floor; it was demolished in 1847. The castle pond in the Střela valley was part of the town's defences and disappeared after a flood at the end of the 19th century. The dam with its weir and a stone two-arched bridge survive. The castle mill disappeared after 1960.

html.Kdysi dávno, v době přemyslovských králů: Long ago, in the days of the Přemyslid kings, the monastery estate at Toužim was run by Provost Dluhoš. He was very capable, but also very greedy. He grew rich at the expense of his subjects and of the monastery, and hid the wealth he amassed in the cellars of his house. Word of Dluhoš's deeds reached the abbot himself. He came to Toužim with his fellow canons to question the provost, but Dluhoš would not give up his riches and kept denying what he had done. As punishment he was dressed in a black habit and, as the "black sheep" of the order, walled up in the vaults of the provostry together with his stolen treasure.
html.Z klášterního statku se stal hrad, z hra: The monastery estate became a castle, and the castle a château. Through the centuries the soul of the "black monk" has wandered the underground passages. It will only be set free when someone with a pure heart finds Dluhoš's treasure and gives it to those in need.
